CONCLUDED 2026-06-17 (not viable in current scene). In-tick spatial diagnostic (diff burst frames → motion centroid, 70 labeled detections w/ frames on disk: 18 real-animal incl wrong_species, 52 FP). FP and animal motion centroids are spatially ENTANGLED — both center-weighted (median ~0.5/0.5). NO edge band removes FP without removing a comparable-or-greater share of animals: left15% catches 8%FP vs 17%animals (hurts animals MORE), right15% 12%FP vs 11%animals (wash), top15% 10%FP vs 11%animals (wash), bottom15% 0 animals but only 1/52 FP (negligible). No zero-observed-FN ROI exists → FN-veto stands on data, not assumption. Reinforces exp #4 (motion knobs don't separate FP from animal) + exp #1 (notification-layer REVIEW prefix is the right architecture, not trigger-side suppression). See JOURNAL 2026-06-17.

CONCLUDED 2026-07-07 (shipped). The sharpness floor (min_sharpness_threshold=11.0) in _capture_and_select_best_frame silently discarded low-light/dusk captures (return None,None before DB logging or notification), causing unrecorded false negatives — e.g. the 07-07 ~19:10 pond bird detected 17x across 4 captured bursts, never logged. Fix: below-floor bursts now always get species ID + a DB row; alert if an animal is found (even blurry), mute (DB-log only, no Telegram) if not, so REVIEW volume does not rise. fn_risk down, fp_rate unchanged. Shipped on branch fix/human-gate-blur-gate. See runs/0005 + JOURNAL 2026-07-08.

ROLLED BACK 2026-07-09 (same day as ship). AE=short was meant to raise dusk sharpness_score above the 11.0 floor. Measurement on saved frames shows it CANNOT: sharpness_score is Laplacian variance, which scales with frame contrast/brightness; AE=short lowers luma by construction (19h matched-hour: luma 68.9->52.0), so it pushes MORE bursts below the floor, not fewer. Run 0006's own pre-registered 'midday regression => reconsider' trigger also fired (16h lap 19.18->15.07). FN unmeasured + plausible FN rise via the below-floor+no-animal mute path => FN-veto => reverted to AE=normal. Reopened as running to collect the matched-hour 17-19h AE=normal baseline that was never captured. CONCLUDED 2026-07-10: AE=normal dusk baseline now in (07-10 17-18h sharpness 6.9-9.4) and is indistinguishable from AE=short (07-09 17-18h 7.8-8.6) — both below the 11.0 floor. AE mode is not the lever; the floor statistic is (backlog id 8, now active). AE=normal retained. See runs/0006.

CONCLUDED 2026-07-21 (KEEP, live). ROOT CAUSE behind exp #6/#5: min_sharpness_threshold=11.0 on raw Laplacian variance is a SCENE-BRIGHTNESS gate, not a blur gate (P(lap<11.0)=0% luma>=80, 71% luma 60-80, 100% luma<40 over 470 frames), so at dusk the blur-gate mute path fires as a function of darkness. Fix (c/b hybrid) SHIPPED 2026-07-18 commit 683f5f3: blur_mute_min_luma=70.0 — below-floor no-animal review-class bursts are only muted when luma>=70; when luma<70 (genuinely dark) they flow to REVIEW instead of being silently muted, closing the unobservable-dusk-FN class. Validated over two dusk-heavy nights (07-20, 07-21), both FN-veto CLEAN (0 concealed animals across 14 adjudicated review-class muted/un-muted frames). 07-21 volume bump quantified: 9/12 below-floor no-animal dusk frames luma<70 -> un-muted to REVIEW (all true-negative empty scenes), 3 muted; ~9 extra REVIEW msgs/dusk-night, no guardrail trip. 0 MAIN leaks; dusk birds (incl. below-floor 2749) correctly routed to MAIN. Rollback = git revert 683f5f3 + restart, or raise the knob. See runs/0007.

nightly_verdict: Busy gardening day — 217 triggers, 122 of them people. Three of the REVIEW alerts you got were actually close-up photos of a person that the privacy filter couldn't recognise as human, so I shipped a fix: from tomorrow, review alerts within two minutes of a confirmed person are held back. It costs no missed animals — I checked every animal you've ever flagged in that channel and none were near a person.
